Name: Content Patcher - More Beds in Farmhouse
Author: DitDit
Description: This is my first mod, and it includes a new room in the beginner Farmhouse (i will update it and add the room to upgraded versions.) which stores three working beds. This mod will be useful in multiplayer (but do bear in mind, i haven't tested it.) as that means you can all live together. Also, thanks to the Stardew Valley discord for helping me make the beds work.

Manifest.Name: MoreBedrooms FarmHouse
Manifest.Description: Adds more bedrooms to the farmhouse.
